messages:
ayesha: heads-up: we'll start emitting small 'cache_probe' events from edge proxies to improve SLA watermarks. They'll look like usage events but should not be billable. tagging billing + eng-platform
carlos: can you share the payload shape so invoice-preview doesn't accidentally surface them?
marta: also want a canary plan and a pre-agg filter in invoice-staging. last time a shadow event slipped in and a preview row terrified a customer :grimacing:
ayesha: payload example: POST /metering/ingest { "event_type": "cache_probe", "tenant_id": "t-abc", "route_id": "r-main", "probe_id": "cp:edge-4:555", "dedupe_key": "cp:edge-4:555", "billable": false, "cost_tag": "internal_probe" }
carlos: please use an explicit billable=false field (easier to SQL filter) and keep cost_tag for telemetry. important: quotas must still see them so do not alter tenant_id/route_id resolution
marta: add a small dedupe window note. if dedupe window shorter than backfill replay windows we could get duplicates in archived invoices. what's dedupe window?
ayesha: dedupe window = 20m currently. ledger-builder will treat billable=false as non-cost and invoice-staging will prefilter by cost_tag or billable flag before aggregation. we'll add unit + integration tests for replay scenarios
carlos: canary plan: 0.5% tenants -> 5% -> 25% with a 1h observation window at each step. emit metric metering.cache_probe.count{canary=true} and a dashboard card
marta: UI: invoice-preview must hide these by default and show a compact banner "Internal probe events suppressed" with a link to docs. power-users can toggle show_internal=true
ayesha: deploy-bot: ayesha/cache-probe-canary deployed to edge-4 cluster — 2026-03-21T14:02Z :rocket:
ledger-bot: NOTICE: edge-4 observed +2.1% event volume during canary window. running invoice-staging sanity check
carlos: ensure invoice-staging filter happens before any tokenization/cost-lookup transforms. otherwise tokens could be created then later filtered and still affect intermediate aggregates
marta: backfill plan: tools/probe-reconcile --from=2026-03-20T22:00Z --to=2026-03-21T16:00Z. It finds ledger rows referencing dedupe_key cp:* and creates a review ticket. no automatic invoice edits without manual signoff
ayesha: adding telemetry tag cache_probe_migration=2026-03-21 to all metrics and traces for quick grep. I'll open ENG ticket with checklist and runbook
carlos: add alert: probe.dedupe_collisions > 0 and invoice-preview.delta > 0 (unexpected). pin those to the metering ops dashboard
marta: don't forget to add a small unit test in ledger/aggregator that asserts billable=false rows never contribute to invoice totals
ayesha: will add tests + integration, dashboard, runbook. will post update after 5% ramp. thanks all :thumbsup:
